text:
Ravi (sec): noticing failures in the nightly base-image rebuild canary. Looks KMS-related; cosign failing to sign manifests. Filing here.
Nina (eng-infra): looking into IAM diffs from the maintenance window. I may have tightened a binding on the key ring.
Carlos (eng-runtime): what error?
Ravi (sec): `cosign: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = request missing permission kms.cryptoKeys.encrypt`
ops-bot: [automated] KMS denied calls (4) for key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/repo/cryptoKeys/image-sign at 1718104225. Callers: image-builder, canary-runner.
Nina (eng-infra): confirmed: the recent infra PR removed a role binding for `image-builder-sa`. I'll reapply scoped role on the specific cryptoKey.
Carlos (eng-runtime): please scope it to the key resource and add an annotation "temp-until=2024-05-10T03:00:00Z" so we can track ephemeral grants. Also add a preflight in CI to fail early if binding missing.
Ravi (sec): add SIEM forwarding for the IAM change and denied events. We need an alert rule: >2 kms.PERMISSION_DENIED in 30m -> post to #eng-security.
Nina (eng-infra): re-added `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the key for image-builder-sa at 1718104400. Left PR note: temporary restore, follow-up to automate TTL.
ops-bot: [automated] IAM policy update recorded and forwarded to SIEM at 1718104480.
Carlos (eng-runtime): kicked canary sign, now `cosign: signature upload OK`. Will add the CI preflight PR.
Ravi (sec): thanks. Follow-ups: PR for preflight, ticket for ephemeral grant automation, and add the alert. Closing when PRs merge. :white_check_mark:
